entry.title: New: Resolution 185 (2024-2026) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AUTHORIZES THE CONTINUED EMPLOYMENT OF LEONG KUNIHIRO BROOKE & KIM, AS SPECIAL COUNSEL TO REPRESENT THE COUNTY OF HAWAIʻI, DEPARTMENT OF HUMAN RESOURCES, WORKERS’ COMPENSATION DIVISION

Extends the retention of Special Counsel Services with additional compensation of $120,000 and total compensation not to exceed $420,000.

Latest action: Council: Adopts Res. 185-25, Draft 2 & GOEAC-43 - 6/18/25
